_comment: Edit this file to add companies or search terms. Board tokens are the company slug in the public job-board URL. Entries were checked to return live postings on 2026-10-13; boards can disappear, and failures are logged and skipped.

workable._note: Workable rate-limits bursts; keep this list short-ish and the interval >= 3h.

remotive._note: One call per run for all software-dev jobs; Remotive asks for at most ~4 calls/day.

remoteok._note: Empty tag = latest jobs of all kinds; titles are filtered by the bot.

arbeitnow._note: Mostly European/German roles; disabled by default for an India-focused search.

adzuna._note: Needs free ADZUNA_APP_ID and ADZUNA_APP_KEY from https://developer.adzuna.com. Skipped when keys are absent. 7 queries x 3 locations x 1 page = 21 calls per fetch, every 8h = ~63/day (check your Adzuna plan's daily/monthly caps).

_comment_intervals: min_interval_hours: the workflow runs hourly, but a source is fetched at most this often. Remotive asks for <=4 calls/day; Adzuna's free plan has daily/monthly call caps.
